summary: Assess utility performance, revenue collection, and financing readiness. Build a practical improvement plan in this five-day course. Explore the outline.
lede: Water utility creditworthiness training helps utility leaders assess operating and financial performance and prepare for financing decisions. It is designed for utility executives, finance and commercial managers, performance teams, public officials, and finance partners who need to interpret collection and cash-flow data, compare financing options, and prioritize capital investment. Participants use IBNET indicators and ISO 24512 concepts to develop a utility-level improvement plan and lender-facing reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for water utility performance, revenue, governance, public oversight, and infrastructure financing decisions.
prerequisites: Recommended: experience in water utility operations, utility finance, public infrastructure oversight, or infrastructure financing. Familiarity with basic financial statements and utility performance reporting will help you complete the case analysis. No coding or programming is required.
